description: `renderPhaseTree()` in `plans/overview.html:1426` falls back through `task.title || node.visibleText || task.id`. No task entry in `plans/overview-data.js` defines `task.title`, so the first branch is dead today. All 5 existing `task-ref` nodes carry `visibleText` so the renderer works, but any new task-ref node authored without `visibleText` will degrade to the bare task id (e.g., `perf-WS3` instead of the human-readable phase-tree label). The plan's schema documents `task.title` as the authoritative phase-tree label, so the contract is half-implemented. Codex flagged the same gap.
suggestedFix: Either (a) backfill `title` on every task entry from a human-readable label (e.g., the kanban card-title text) and update the SKILL example to actually use it, or (b) make `visibleText` on every task-ref node a hard requirement in the SKILL.md phase-tree procedure (E) and drop `task.title` from the schema. Tracking this with F-003 (both touch the SKILL.md/data-file consistency story) reduces edit churn.
